name: cot-oracle-ao-benchmark
description: A dataset for evaluating models' ability to produce correct answer options and supporting chain-of-thought reasoning under oracle or CoT-style setups. It appears focused on answer-option (AO) selection tasks with accompanying reasoning traces to permit analysis of reasoning fidelity and final-answer accuracy. The benchmark is hosted on Hugging Face and intended for research into CoT and reasoning evaluation.
reputation: Research-oriented dataset hosted on Hugging Face with limited but growing use in CoT/reasoning studies.
